Company: Acme Corporation - Technology solutions provider. Founded 2005. Headquarters: San Francisco, CA. 2,500 employees across 12 offices. Mission: Empowering businesses through innovative technology.

Work Hours: Standard hours 9am-5pm local time. Core hours (required): 10am-3pm. Flexible scheduling available with manager approval. Full-time: 40 hours/week. Overtime requires pre-approval for non-exempt employees.

Remote Work Policy: Hybrid model - 3 days in office, 2 days remote (Tuesday/Thursday flexibility). Full remote positions available for certain roles. Remote work agreement required. Home office stipend: $500 one-time. Monthly internet reimbursement: $50.

Paid Time Off (PTO): 0-2 years: 15 days. 3-5 years: 20 days. 6+ years: 25 days. PTO accrues monthly. Maximum carryover: 5 days. Request PTO through HR portal. Manager approval required for 5+ consecutive days.
Sick Leave: 10 days per year. Does not roll over. Doctor's note required for 3+ consecutive days. Can be used for personal illness or family care. Mental health days included.

Holidays: 10 paid holidays: New Year's Day, MLK Day, Presidents Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Columbus Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving (2 days), Christmas. Floating holiday: 1 day (use anytime).

Parental Leave: Birth parents: 16 weeks paid. Non-birth parents: 8 weeks paid. Adoption/foster: 8 weeks paid. Must be employed 12+ months. Can be taken within first year of birth/adoption. Return to same or equivalent position guaranteed.
Bereavement Leave: Immediate family (spouse, child, parent, sibling): 5 days paid. Extended family (grandparent, in-law, aunt/uncle): 3 days paid. Additional unpaid leave available upon request.
Jury Duty: Full pay for duration of jury service. Notify manager immediately upon receiving summons. Provide documentation from court. Return to work on days not required for jury service.

Health Insurance: Three plan options: Basic, Standard, Premium. Company pays 80% of employee premium. Family coverage available (company pays 50% of dependent premium). Effective first of month after hire date. Open enrollment: November 1-15.

Health Insurance - Basic Plan: $150/month employee cost. $1,500 deductible. 80/20 coinsurance after deductible. $5,000 out-of-pocket maximum. HSA eligible. Best for healthy individuals with low healthcare usage.
Health Insurance - Standard Plan: $250/month employee cost. $750 deductible. 90/10 coinsurance. $3,000 out-of-pocket maximum. Most popular choice. Good balance of cost and coverage.
Health Insurance - Premium Plan: $400/month employee cost. $250 deductible. 95/5 coinsurance. $1,500 out-of-pocket maximum. Best for families or those with ongoing medical needs.

Dental Insurance: Included with all health plans at no extra cost. Preventive care 100% covered. Basic procedures 80% covered. Major procedures 50% covered. Annual maximum: $2,000. Orthodontia coverage for dependents under 19.
Vision Insurance: Optional: $15/month. Eye exam covered annually. $150 allowance for frames. $150 allowance for contacts. Discounts on LASIK. VSP network.

401(k) Retirement Plan: Eligible after 90 days. Company match: 100% of first 4%, 50% of next 2% (max 5% match). Immediate vesting. Traditional and Roth options. Auto-enrollment at 3% (opt-out available). Target-date funds available.
Life Insurance: Basic life: 1x salary (company paid). Supplemental life: up to 5x salary (employee paid). AD&D included. Beneficiary designation required. Update after major life events.
Disability Insurance: Short-term disability: 60% of salary up to 12 weeks. Long-term disability: 60% of salary after 12 weeks. Company paid. Pre-existing condition waiting period: 12 months.

Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Free confidential counseling (8 sessions/year). Legal consultation. Financial planning. Work-life balance resources. Available to employees and household members. Call 1-800-EAP-HELP.

Tuition Reimbursement: Up to $5,250/year for job-related courses. Degree programs and certifications included. Must be employed 1+ years. Grade requirement: B or higher. Pre-approval required. Two-year commitment after reimbursement.

Professional Development: $1,000 annual learning budget. Conferences, courses, books, subscriptions. Manager approval for expenses over $500. LinkedIn Learning access included. Internal mentorship program available.

Performance Reviews: Annual review in December. Mid-year check-in in June. Self-assessment required. 360 feedback for managers. Ratings: Exceeds, Meets, Developing, Below Expectations. Tied to annual merit increase (February).

Compensation: Annual merit increases: 2-5% based on performance. Promotion increases: typically 10-15%. Cost of living adjustments reviewed annually. Pay transparency: salary bands published internally. Pay equity audits conducted annually.

Bonus Program: Annual bonus target: 10% of salary (individual contributors), 15% (managers), 20% (directors+). Based on company and individual performance. Paid in March. Must be employed through December 31. Prorated for mid-year hires.
Stock Options: Equity grants for eligible roles. 4-year vesting with 1-year cliff. Refresh grants based on performance. Exercise window: 90 days after departure. ISOs and NSOs available.

Expense Reimbursement: Submit expenses within 30 days. Receipts required for expenses over $25. Manager approval for expenses over $100. Corporate card available for frequent travelers. Reimbursement within 2 weeks of approval.

Travel Policy: Book through corporate travel portal for best rates. Airfare: economy class for flights under 6 hours. Hotel: up to $200/night (varies by city). Meals: up to $75/day. Rental car: compact class unless business need. Keep all receipts.

Code of Conduct: Maintain professional behavior. No harassment or discrimination. Report concerns to HR or anonymous hotline. Conflicts of interest must be disclosed. Gifts over $100 must be reported. Social media: don't speak on behalf of company without authorization.

Anti-Harassment Policy: Zero tolerance for harassment of any kind. Protected categories: race, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, etc. Report to HR, manager, or anonymous hotline. Investigation within 5 business days. Retaliation prohibited.

IT Security: Strong passwords required (12+ characters). Multi-factor authentication mandatory. No personal devices for company data without MDM. Report suspicious emails to security@acme.com. Annual security training required.

Equipment: Laptop provided (Mac or Windows choice). Monitor, keyboard, mouse provided for office/home. Return all equipment within 5 days of departure. Reasonable personal use permitted. Report lost/stolen immediately.

Resignation: Two weeks notice expected (four weeks for directors+). Exit interview with HR. Final paycheck includes unused PTO. Benefits end last day of month. COBRA information provided. Return equipment and badge.

Termination: Involuntary termination reviewed by HR and legal. Severance: 2 weeks per year of service (minimum 4 weeks). Outplacement services provided. COBRA and benefits information provided. References limited to dates of employment and title.

Workplace Safety: Report hazards to Facilities or HR. Emergency exits clearly marked. First aid kits in break rooms. Fire drills quarterly. Ergonomic assessments available. Workers' comp for work-related injuries.
